<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class RateLimitStore {
    private array $counters = [];
    private array $timestamps = [];
    private array $locks = [];

    public function increment(string $key, int $window): int {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->timestamps[$key]) || ($now - $this->timestamps[$key]) >= $window) {
            $this->counters[$key] = 1;
            $this->timestamps[$key] = $now;
            return 1;
        }
        $this->counters[$key]++;
        return $this->counters[$key];
    }

    public function getCounter(string $key): int {
        return $this->counters[$key] ?? 0;
    }

    public function setCounter(string $key, int $value): void {
        $this->counters[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function acquireLock(string $key): bool {
        if (isset($this->locks[$key]) && $this->locks[$key]) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->locks[$key] = true;
        return true;
    }

    public function releaseLock(string $key): void {
        unset($this->locks[$key]);
    }
}

class SessionToken {
    public string $sessionId;
    public string $userId;
    public int $createdAt;
    public int $expiresAt;
    public string $fingerprint;

    public function __construct(string $sessionId, string $userId, int $createdAt, int $expiresAt, string $fingerprint) {
        $this->sessionId = $sessionId;
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->createdAt = $createdAt;
        $this->expiresAt = $expiresAt;
        $this->fingerprint = $fingerprint;
    }
}

class AuthenticationService {
    private const MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS = 5;
    private const LOCKOUT_WINDOW = 900; // 15 minutes
    private const SESSION_DURATION = 3600;
    private const HMAC_ALGO = 'sha256';

    private string $secretKey;
    private RateLimitStore $store;
    private array $sessions = [];
    private array $auditLog = [];

    public function __construct(string $secretKey, RateLimitStore $store) {
        if (strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Secret key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
        $this->store = $store;
    }

    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password, string $clientFingerprint): ?SessionToken {
        $sanitizedUser = $this->sanitizeUsername($username);
        if ($sanitizedUser === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!$this->checkRateLimit($sanitizedUser)) {
            $this->logAttempt($sanitizedUser, 'rate_limited');
            return null;
        }

        $storedHash = $this->lookupPasswordHash($sanitizedUser);
        if ($storedHash === null) {
            // Constant-time comparison even for non-existent users
            password_verify($password, '$2y$12$InvalidHashForTimingProtection000000000000000000000000');
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($sanitizedUser);
            $this->logAttempt($sanitizedUser, 'user_not_found');
            return null;
        }

        if (!password_verify($password, $storedHash)) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($sanitizedUser);
            $this->logAttempt($sanitizedUser, 'invalid_password');
            return null;
        }

        $this->resetRateLimit($sanitizedUser);
        $session = $this->createSession($sanitizedUser, $clientFingerprint);
        $this->logAttempt($sanitizedUser, 'success');
        return $session;
    }

    private function checkRateLimit(string $username): bool {
        $key = 'login_attempts:' . $username;
        $attempts = $this->store->getCounter($key);
        
        // Check if attempts exceed maximum
        if ($attempts >= self::MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function recordFailedAttempt(string $username): void {
        $key = 'login_attempts:' . $username;
        $current = $this->store->increment($key, self::LOCKOUT_WINDOW);
        
        // Overflow protection: if counter somehow becomes negative or exceeds
        // a reasonable bound, we cap it. This handles edge cases in distributed
        // environments where concurrent increments might cause issues.
        if ($current > 1000000) {
            $this->store->setCounter($key, self::MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS);
        }
    }

    private function resetRateLimit(string $username): void {
        $key = 'login_attempts:' . $username;
        $this->store->setCounter($key, 0);
    }

    private function createSession(string $userId, string $fingerprint): SessionToken {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $now = time();
        $expires = $now + self::SESSION_DURATION;
        
        $token = new SessionToken($sessionId, $userId, $now, $expires, $fingerprint);
        $this->sessions[$sessionId] = $token;
        return $token;
    }

    public function validateSession(string $sessionId, string $clientFingerprint): ?SessionToken {
        if (!isset($this->sessions[$sessionId])) {
            return null;
        }

        $session = $this->sessions[$sessionId];
        
        if (time() > $session->expiresAt) {
            unset($this->sessions[$sessionId]);
            return null;
        }

        if (!hash_equals($session->fingerprint, $clientFingerprint)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $session;
    }

    public function generateSignedToken(SessionToken $session): string {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'sid' => $session->sessionId,
            'uid' => $session->userId,
            'exp' => $session->expiresAt,
            'fp' => $session->fingerprint
        ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $signature = hash_hmac(self::HMAC_ALGO, $payload, $this->secretKey, true);
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . base64_encode($signature);
    }

    public function verifySignedToken(string $token): ?SessionToken {
        $parts = explode('.', $token, 2);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }

        $payloadRaw = base64_decode($parts[0], true);
        $providedSig = base64_decode($parts[1], true);

        if ($payloadRaw === false || $providedSig === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $expectedSig = hash_hmac(self::HMAC_ALGO, $payloadRaw, $this->secretKey, true);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return null;
        }

        $data = json_decode($payloadRaw, true);
        if (!is_array($data) || !isset($data['sid'], $data['uid'], $data['exp'], $data['fp'])) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!is_string($data['sid']) || !is_string($data['uid']) || !is_int($data['exp']) || !is_string($data['fp'])) {
            return null;
        }

        if (time() > $data['exp']) {
            return null;
        }

        return new SessionToken($data['sid'], $data['uid'], 0, $data['exp'], $data['fp']);
    }

    private function sanitizeUsername(string $input): ?string {
        $trimmed = trim($input);
        if (strlen($trimmed) < 3 || strlen($trimmed) > 64) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9._@-]+$/', $trimmed)) {
            return null;
        }
        return strtolower($trimmed);
    }

    private function lookupPasswordHash(string $username): ?string {
        // Simulated user store - in production this queries a database
        $users = [
            'admin' => '$2y$12$LJ3m4sMKfRJx5Yq5B5v5aeQPQ5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5z5u',
            'alice' => '$2y$12$abcdefghijklmnopqrstuuABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ012345',
        ];
        return $users[$username] ?? null;
    }

    private function logAttempt(string $username, string $result): void {
        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'time' => time(),
            'user' => $username,
            'result' => $result
        ];
    }

    public function getAuditLog(): array {
        return $this->auditLog;
    }

    /**
     * Administrative endpoint to manually set attempt counter.
     * Used by monitoring systems to trigger lockouts on suspicious IPs.
     * Accepts the raw counter value from the monitoring payload.
     */
    public function setAttemptCounter(string $username, string $rawValue): bool {
        $sanitizedUser = $this->sanitizeUsername($username);
        if ($sanitizedUser === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $key = 'login_attempts:' . $sanitizedUser;
        // Parse the monitoring system's counter value
        $value = intval($rawValue);
        $this->store->setCounter($key, $value);
        return true;
    }
}

// Entry point
function handleRequest(array $request, string $secretKey): array {
    $store = new RateLimitStore();
    $auth = new AuthenticationService($secretKey, $store);

    $action = $request['action'] ?? '';

    switch ($action) {
        case 'login':
            $username = $request['username'] ?? '';
            $password = $request['password'] ?? '';
            $fingerprint = $request['fingerprint'] ?? '';
            
            $session = $auth->authenticate($username, $password, $fingerprint);
            if ($session === null) {
                return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Authentication failed'];
            }
            $token = $auth->generateSignedToken($session);
            return ['status' => 'ok', 'token' => $token];

        case 'verify':
            $token = $request['token'] ?? '';
            $session = $auth->verifySignedToken($token);
            if ($session === null) {
                return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid token'];
            }
            return ['status' => 'ok', 'user' => $session->userId];

        case 'set_counter':
            $username = $request['username'] ?? '';
            $value = $request['value'] ?? '0';
            $result = $auth->setAttemptCounter($username, $value);
            return ['status' => $result ? 'ok' : 'error'];

        default:
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Unknown action'];
    }
}
